headline: Linn Mercy Surges as Weathered Expanse Holds Hot
war_summary: Since the morning wire Linn Mercy has doubled its pace to eight transfers in two hours and thirty-five on the day centred on Lathair and Outwich Ranch for ten Colonial holdings and one no-man's-land, last recorded at 1156, with casualties on the day near five thousand Colonial and nine thousand Warden and still accelerating. The Weathered Expanse eased to six in two hours but grew to fifty-three on the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch, Wightwalk and Necropolis for five Warden, two Colonial and two no-man's-land holdings, last at 1126. The Nevish Line has gone quiet with none in two hours and thirty-three on the day about Blackcoat Way, last at 0831, for six Warden and two Colonial holdings, though losses near seventy-five hundred a side are accelerating sharply. Mooring County is also quiet with none in two hours and twenty-four on the day about the Wind Hills, now listed at twelve Warden holdings, last at 0931. Marban Hollow reports none in two hours and thirty on the day about Checkpoint Bua, last at 0346, for four Warden, three Colonial and one no-man's-land, while Callahan's Passage records about sixty-eight hundred Colonial and fifty-four hundred Warden losses without a transfer.
